title: Coordinate Position Checkpoint
description: Show that you can describe positions of points in the Cartesian plane and support geometric descriptions with coordinates.

questions.question: Which point is 2 units left and 7 units down from the origin?
questions.explanation: Left gives a negative x-coordinate, and down gives a negative y-coordinate, so the point is (-2, -7).

questions.question: A point has coordinates (-8, -3). Which statement is correct?
questions.explanation: Both coordinates are negative, so the point is in Quadrant III.

questions.question: Which point is on the y-axis?
questions.explanation: A point is on the y-axis when its x-coordinate is 0.

questions.question: Which point is on the x-axis?
questions.explanation: A point is on the x-axis when its y-coordinate is 0.

questions.question: The point (0, -5) is in Quadrant IV.
questions.explanation: The point (0, -5) is on the y-axis because x = 0. Points on axes are not in quadrants.

questions.question: Write the ordered pair for a point on the x-axis that is 9 units right of the origin.
questions.explanation: A point on the x-axis has y = 0. Nine units right gives x = 9, so the point is (9, 0).

questions.question: Points P(-3, 6) and Q(5, 6) are best described as:
options: Vertically aligned because they have the same x-coordinate
Horizontally aligned because they have the same y-coordinate
questions.explanation: Both points have y-coordinate 6, so they lie on the same horizontal line.

questions.question: Points R(-4, -2) and S(-4, 5) are best described as:
options: Horizontally aligned because they have the same y-coordinate
Vertically aligned because they have the same x-coordinate
questions.explanation: Both points have x-coordinate -4, so they lie on the same vertical line.

questions.question: Explain in one or two sentences why (4, 0) is not in Quadrant I.
questions.correctAnswer: The point (4, 0) has y-coordinate 0, so it lies on the x-axis. Points on an axis are not inside any quadrant.
questions.explanation: The key idea is that a zero coordinate can place a point on an axis, and axis points are not assigned to quadrants.

questions.question: A student says that A(-1, 5) is below B(-1, -2) because -1 is less than 5. Explain the mistake.
questions.correctAnswer: The student compared the wrong coordinates. To decide which point is higher or lower, compare y-coordinates: 5 is greater than -2, so A is above B.
questions.explanation: Vertical position depends on the y-coordinate, not the x-coordinate or a comparison between x and y from one point.
